description: The inspection and penalty record of one U.S. nursing home from CMS data: star ratings, staffing, fines and payment denials, how many inspection citations it has (and how many at the actual-harm or immediate-jeopardy level), its most recent citations with dates, its chain and its owner organisations. Find it by CCN (6-character CMS number) or by name plus state or city. Returns other close matches when a name is ambiguous.

ccn.description: CMS Certification Number: 6 characters, the two-digit state code then four digits.

city.description: City, to narrow a name match.

name.description: Facility name, e.g. "Pinecrest Example Care Center".

state.description: U.S. state as a two-letter code (NY) or full name (New York).

name: check_nursing_home
title: Check a nursing home
